headline: Sensex and Nifty trade strong as Orient Green surges on debut while Runwal and Acevector fall
hook: Strong debut for Orient Green shares
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded strong in the latest session. Amid market movements, Orient Green Power saw its shares surge 51 percent on its market debut. Conversely, shares of Runwal and Acevector witnessed a decline. Retail investors tracking new listings should note the diverging performance among newly traded stocks.
why_it_matters: New listings show starkly contrasting retail investor demand.
winners_losers: Orient Green investors gain / Runwal and Acevector hurt
